domain(person,[zain]).

axiom(s1, xor(identifies_with_multiple_cultures(zain), homogeneous_upbringing(zain))).

% Either Zain has a strong sense of belonging or he struggles with his identity, but not both.
axiom(s2, xor(strong_sense_of_belonging(zain), struggles_with_identity(zain))).

% Anyone who experiences different cultures and values their heritage can have a unique perspective.
axiom(s3, rule([experiences_different_cultures(X), values_heritage(X)], unique_perspective(X))).

% Zain either has a strong sense of belonging or fully embraces his cultural diversity, but not both.
axiom(s4, xor(strong_sense_of_belonging(zain), fully_embraces_cultural_diversity(zain))).

% Zain experiences different cultures.
axiom(s5, experiences_different_cultures(zain)).

% For Zain, he either has a homogeneous upbringing or fully embraces his cultural diversity, but not both.
axiom(s6, xor(homogeneous_upbringing(zain), fully_embraces_cultural_diversity(zain))).

% Zain values his heritage.
axiom(s7, values_heritage(zain)).

% If someone grows up abroad and speaks multiple languages, then they have a unique perspective.
axiom(s8, rule([grows_up_abroad(X), speaks_multiple_languages(X)], unique_perspective(X))).

% Zain either has a unique perspective or identifies with multiple cultures, but not both.
axiom(s9, xor(unique_perspective(zain), identifies_with_multiple_cultures(zain))).
